IN_TRANSIT_02.eng_meaning: Parcels have arrived at the sorting center.

IN_TRANSIT_04.eng_meaning: Dispatching, the package has been encapsulated and will be sent to the airport soon.
IN_TRANSIT_04.chn_meaning: 包裹已封装，即将送往机场

IN_TRANSIT_05.eng_meaning: The package has been handed over to the airline and is being sent to the destination country.
IN_TRANSIT_05.chn_meaning: 包裹已交航空公司，运往目的国

IN_TRANSIT_06.eng_meaning: Landed, the package has arrived in the destination country.

IN_TRANSIT_07.eng_meaning: The parcel has arrived at the local post office or courier outlet and delivery will be arranged soon.
IN_TRANSIT_07.chn_meaning: 包裹已到达当地网点，即将派送

IN_TRANSIT_08.eng_meaning: The package is on the plane and the plane has departed.
IN_TRANSIT_08.chn_meaning: 包裹已上飞机，航班已起飞

WAITING_DELIVERY_01.eng_meaning: The parcel is out for delivery.

WAITING_DELIVERY_02.eng_meaning: The parcel has arrived at the collection point for receipts to pick up.
WAITING_DELIVERY_02.chn_meaning: 包裹已到自提点，等待领取

WAITING_DELIVERY_03.eng_meaning: The recipient requests a delayed delivery or the courier leaves a note after a failed delivery waiting for a second delivery.
WAITING_DELIVERY_03.chn_meaning: 收件人要求延迟派送或投递失败后等待二次派送

DELIVERED_02.eng_meaning: Successful pick-up by the recipient at the collection point.
DELIVERED_02.chn_meaning: 收件人在自提点已领取包裹

DELIVERED_03.eng_meaning: Parcel delivered and signed by the customer.

DELIVERED_04.eng_meaning: Parcel delivered to the recipient’s property, which may include delivery to property owners, doormen, family members, neighbors, or being left at the front door, porch, or a safe place near the entrance.
DELIVERED_04.chn_meaning: 包裹已投递至收件人地址，可能由房主、门卫、家人、邻居代收，或放置在家门口、门廊（Front Door / Porch）或其他安全位置。

DELIVERY_FAILED_01.eng_meaning: Delivery failed due to address related issues.

DELIVERY_FAILED_02.eng_meaning: Delivery failed due to the recipient was not at home.
DELIVERY_FAILED_02.chn_meaning: 因收件人不在家派送失败

DELIVERY_FAILED_03.eng_meaning: Delivery failed due to the recipient can not being reached.
DELIVERY_FAILED_03.chn_meaning: 因无法联系上收件人派送失败

DELIVERY_FAILED_04.eng_meaning: Delivery failed due to other reasons.

ABNORMAL_03.eng_meaning: The package is damaged, lost, or discarded.
ABNORMAL_03.chn_meaning: 包裹损坏、丢失或被丢弃

ABNORMAL_05.eng_meaning: The recipient refuses to accept the parcel.

ABNORMAL_06.eng_meaning: The return package has been successfully received by the sender.
ABNORMAL_06.chn_meaning: 退回包裹已被发件人接收

ABNORMAL_07.eng_meaning: The package is on its way to the sender.
ABNORMAL_07.chn_meaning: 包裹正在返回发件人途中

INFO_RECEIVED_01.eng_meaning: The carrier has received a request from the shipper and is preparing to pick up the package.
INFO_RECEIVED_01.chn_meaning: 承运方已收到发件人请求，正在揽件
